items.source: Scoring based on cosine similarity between two vectors.
items.translation: 基于两个向量之间的余弦相似度进行评分。

items.source: Scoring based on the dot product (also known as inner product) between two vectors.
items.translation: 基于两个向量之间的点积（也称为内积）进行评分。

items.source: Scoring based on the Euclidean distance between two vectors.
items.translation: 基于两个向量之间的欧几里得距离进行评分。

items.source: Scoring based on the Hamming distance between two vectors or strings.
items.translation: 基于两个向量或字符串之间的汉明距离进行评分。

items.source: Scoring based on taxicab (Manhattan) distance.
items.translation: 基于出租车（曼哈顿）距离的评分。

items.source: Computes the L2 norm, involving a square root operation. Typically more computationally expensive than COSINE or DOT_PRODUCT, but precise in spatial distance measurement.
items.translation: 计算 L2 范数，涉及平方根运算。通常比COSINE或DOT_PRODUCT在计算上更昂贵，但在空间距离测量方面更为精确。

items.source: Measures the angle between vectors, independent of their magnitude. Involves a DOT_PRODUCT and normalization, offering a balance between precision and performance.
items.translation: 测量向量之间的角度，与它们的幅度无关。涉及DOT_PRODUCT和归一化，在精度和性能之间取得平衡。

items.source:
Provides a set of standard scoring strategies for comparing vectors in search or matching operations. Includes
options such as Euclidean distance, cosine similarity, and dot product.
items.translation: 提供了一套用于搜索或匹配操作中比较向量的标准评分策略。包括欧几里得距离、余弦相似度和点积等选项。

items.source:
These constants are intended for reuse across components requiring vector scoring semantics. Each scoring function
represents a mathematical approach to quantifying the similarity or distance between vectors in a multidimensional
space.
items.translation: 这些常量旨在供需要向量评分语义的各个组件复用。每个评分函数代表一种在多维空间中量化向量间相似度或距离的数学方法。

items.source: When selecting a scoring function, consider the specific requirements of your application domain:
items.translation: 在选择评分函数时，请考虑您应用领域的具体需求：

items.source: Efficient to compute and particularly useful in high-dimensional vector spaces.
items.translation: 计算高效，尤其适用于高维向量空间。

items.source:
Computes the sum of absolute differences across dimensions. Useful in contexts where axis-aligned movement or L1
norms are preferred.
items.translation: 计算各维度上的绝对差之和。在偏好轴对齐移动或L1范数的上下文中非常有用。

items.source:
Counts the number of differing positions. Suitable for binary (bitwise) vectors or fixed-length character
sequences.
items.translation: 计算不同位置的数量。适用于二进制（按位）向量或固定长度的字符序列。

items.source: Typically used for display or configuration purposes.
items.translation: 通常用于显示或配置目的。

items.source:
• For spatial distance measurements where magnitude matters, use EUCLIDEAN.
  • For directional similarity irrespective of magnitude, use COSINE.
  • For efficient high-dimensional calculations, use DOT_PRODUCT.
  • For grid-based or axis-aligned problems, use TAXICAB.
  • For binary vector or string comparisons, use HAMMING.
items.translation:
• 对于需要衡量幅度的空间距离计算，请使用EUCLIDEAN。
  • 对于不考虑幅度仅关注方向相似性的情况，请使用COSINE。
  • 对于高效的高维计算，请使用DOT_PRODUCT。
  • 对于基于网格或轴对齐的问题，请使用TAXICAB。
  • 对于二进制向量或字符串比较，请使用HAMMING。

  • 若需衡量方向相似性而忽略幅度，请使用COSINE。
  • 为进行高效的高维计算，请使用DOT_PRODUCT。

  • 对于二进制向量或字符串的比较，请使用HAMMING。
The choice of scoring function can significantly impact the relevance of the results returned by a Vector Search query. ScoringFunction and score values are typically subject to fine-tuning during the development to achieve optimal performance and accuracy.
items.translation:
• 对于需要关注距离大小的空间距离测量，请使用EUCLIDEAN。
  • 若需衡量方向相似性而忽略幅度，请使用COSINE。
  • 为进行高效的高维计算，请使用DOT_PRODUCT。
  • 对于基于网格或轴对齐的问题，请使用TAXICAB。
  • 对于二进制向量或字符串的比较，请使用HAMMING。
评分函数的选择会显著影响向量搜索查询返回结果的相关性。ScoringFunction和分数值通常在开发过程中需要微调，以实现最佳的性能和准确性。
